tools.name: search_nonprofits
tools.description: Find nonprofits. Use Identity for a named organization or EIN and Discovery for a cause or mission. State refers to headquarters. Explicit metric sorts in Discovery rank indexed name/classification matches; inspect MatchScope before claiming population coverage.

tools.name: ask_research_assistant
tools.description: Ask the public AI research assistant for 100 credits from the shared daily allowance. No key required. The question is sent to the configured AI provider; results may be incomplete.

tools.name: start_research
tools.description: Start public durable AI research for 100 credits. No key required; internal reads are included. Reuse the idempotency key for a free retry; polling and cancellation are free. tools.name: get_research
tools.description: Get the current status or result of your research job. Pass the exact ResearchID and private AccessToken returned by start_research; polling without a token requires the original client identity. Read data.Status for the job state; outer status describes the tool call. Polling is free.

tools.name: cancel_research
tools.description: Request cancellation of your research job. Pass the exact ResearchID and private AccessToken returned by start_research; without a token the original client identity is required. tools.name: get_nonprofit
tools.description: Get a nonprofit's selected profile and its available section manifest.

tools.name: get_rating_methodology
tools.description: Explain the active rating policy for a filing form. Use the nonprofit profile for its actual score and evidence.

tools.name: get_nonprofit_section
tools.description: Get one section and its original evidence. Use section IDs and evidence references returned by CharitySense.

tools.name: list_nonprofit_filings
tools.description: List available filings for the selected form.

tools.name: review_nonprofit
tools.description: Assemble a bounded deterministic review; pass the continuation cursor to resume.

tools.name: review_donation
tools.description:
Assemble donor evidence for a proposed gift. Ask for useful missing context; never invent it.

    Values in decision_context are donor-provided. Current websites, registries and gift acceptance are not verified by this tool.
    Repeat identical decision_context when following a continuation cursor

tools.name: compare_nonprofits
tools.description: Compare selected profile contexts; disclose periods and missing evidence.

tools.name: rank_nonprofit_candidates
tools.description: Rank up to 25 caller-selected nonprofits by their live CharitySense scores; does not verify candidate eligibility or cover a population.

tools.name: get_diligence_summary
tools.description: Get existing grant readiness and financial summaries for up to 25 nonprofits.

tools.name: get_money_network
tools.description: Retrieve latest filed money relationships with evidence and pagination.

tools.name: get_funding_relationships
tools.description: Retrieve indexed funding relationships with resolved EINs; this is not a complete list of filed grants.

tools.name: discover_related_nonprofits
tools.description: Discover related nonprofits using the existing research service.

tools.name: get_api_usage
tools.description: Read the current caller's research allowance without consuming it.
